verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of admin message-history search with sender, channel, or date filters. The Export APIs (ms-teams-docs-13/14) only let developers pull messages out of Teams, which is a building block and not a search capability, so they earn no credit. Community reports of weak search, including no way to search within a channel, add no documented capability, and with no vendor claim to contradict there is nothing to mark as disputed.
